chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
There were white, loose turbans upon the Angels on the Day of Badr.
ai.seo_question: What were the Angels wearing during the Battle of Badr?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the specific attire of the angels during the Battle of Badr, emphasizing the white, loose turbans (al-'imam al-bisat) as a sign of their status and purity. In Shia scholarly tradition, this detail is often cited to establish the Sunnah of wearing white turbans, linking the celestial realm's appearance to the earthly conduct of the faithful. It underscores the spiritual significance of dress in Islamic worship and the tangible presence of the unseen world during key historical moments.
